name: Room Connection and Modal Interaction Test
description: Verifies that room code is assigned immediately upon load, clicking room status pill opens room management modal, creating a new room updates the room code, and modal closes properly.

planSteps.description: Verify that room code indicator displays an active 6-character room code instead of staying stuck on BAĞLANIYOR
Click on the room status pill in the top right header
Verify that the Room Management Modal opens, showing the current room code, username input, and action buttons
Click the 'Yeni Oda Oluştur' button inside the modal
Verify that a new room is created, toast notification is displayed, and the modal closes
